description: This file contains R code for managing Spark sessions, contexts, and related utilities in SparkR. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and configuring Spark sessions, handling JVM connections, and managing job groups and tags.

methods.name: sparkR.session
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves the current SparkSession, with options for configuration and Hive support.

methods.name: sparkR.stop
methods.description: Stops the current Spark session and context, terminating connections and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: sparkR.uiWebUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of the Spark Web UI for the current Spark session.

methods.name: setJobGroup
methods.description: Assigns a group ID to all jobs started in the current thread.

methods.name: clearJobGroup
methods.description: Clears the current job group ID and description.

methods.name: cancelJobGroup
methods.description: Cancels all active jobs associated with the specified group ID.

methods.name: setInterruptOnCancel
methods.description: Sets whether job cancellation should interrupt the executor threads.

methods.name: addJobTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to all jobs started in the current thread.

methods.name: removeJobTag
methods.description: Removes a previously added job tag.

methods.name: getJobTags
methods.description: Retrieves all tags currently assigned to jobs in the current thread.

methods.name: clearJobTags
methods.description: Clears all job tags for the current thread.

methods.name: cancelJobsWithTag
methods.description: Cancels all active jobs with the specified tag.

methods.name: setJobDescription
methods.description: Sets a human-readable description for the current job.

methods.name: setLocalProperty
methods.description: Sets a local property affecting jobs submitted from this thread.

methods.name: getLocalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a local property set in this thread.
